implementation_notes: Added WriteSelected(io.Writer, []Entry, func(string) bool) error; nil includes all, rejected entries are filtered before creation or body access, and selected names/contents/order remain intact.
WriteArchive retains its exact function type and delegates to WriteSelected with nil.
One deferred ZIP Close runs on every return path. A lone processing or completion error is returned directly; independent causes are joined with errors.Join.

The private archiveOutput wrapper records output failure before completion. ZIP's sticky buffered output failure is returned directly when Close repeats it, without comparing arbitrary error interface values.
Borrowed bodies and output are never closed. README and Godoc explain completion, ownership, partial output and lack of rollback/durability.

Consumer-package tests cover filtering of an invalid name and unreadable/nil skipped bodies, duplicates, ordering, empty archives, nil predicates, signature compatibility, error combinations, early stop, completion after creation failure, borrowed-resource ownership, typed non-comparable errors, and writer failures during creation/copy.

Verified intended red failures before implementation/filtering and used a temporary mutation to prove the non-comparable lone-body identity assertion. Mutation was restored before the final passing full suite.
